opportunity.description: An opportunity is valid only when the learner could reasonably respond.
opportunity.rule: An invalidating condition produces no learning observation at all. It never produces a failed one.

observationOutcomes.meaning: The response provides the required observable evidence.
Relevant evidence exists but one or more material criteria are missing.
A fair opportunity and an assessable response exist, but the criterion was not demonstrated.
No assessable response was produced for that opportunity.
Available information cannot support the judgment.
The observation is malformed, duplicated, stale, cross-session, or otherwise unusable.

allowedEvidenceTypes.meaning: Canonical transcript text from learner and remote utterances.
Typed learner response where that is the offered equitable path.
Deterministic selection or confirmation event tied to an opportunity.

assistance.description: The learning-help context recorded at the moment of an assessable response.
rules: Having a mode enabled does not prove the learner used it.
FULL support may demonstrate participation and objective completion under the approved completion policy, but cannot alone demonstrate STR.INDEPENDENT_RETRIEVAL.
HINT evidence may contribute to developing competence when the actual help item is recorded.
OFF does not guarantee independence if the response was supplied by another route.
Toggling help never creates a transcript utterance or a second provider request.
Assistance usage may become a reward input only under a later approved economy and privacy decision.

accessibilityAccommodation.description: Approved alternative access to the same construct. Recorded separately from learning assistance and never scored as weaker evidence.
rules: An accessibility accommodation is never an assistance mode and never appears in the assistance object.
Using an accommodation cannot reduce an observation outcome, a mastery state, or a confidence dimension.
Where speech is not the construct being assessed, an equitable non-speech route must exist.
No learner is given a pronunciation failure derived from speech-recognition text.
accessibilityAccommodation.separationRule: ASSISTANCE_ACCOMMODATION_CONFLATED is raised if an accommodation value appears as an assistance mode or an assistance field carries an accommodation.

validityRules.rule: A required field is absent or has the wrong type.
The same observation identifier appears more than once in one result.
An observation cites an attempt identifier other than the result's own.
An observation cites a curriculum or rubric version other than the result's own.
A judgment cites no canonical response or utterance identifier.
